headline: Breaking Down Potential Trade Destinations For Lightning Star Nikita Kucherov: The Hockey News Big Show
take:
The Athletic calls Nikita Kucherov's trade request an "out-of-nowhere bombshell," and The Hockey News reports Shane Wright has been traded from the Kraken to the Predators, calling it a fresh start for the former fourth-overall pick.

Kucherov is the bigger story, and our numbers say the request isn't about a decline. So far this season he has 20 points in 15 games, and the Lightning take 58% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) when he plays five-on-five. His team's share also rises by about four percentage points with him on the ice. He is scoring a little below his chances, 4 goals against 4.95 expected, so his production is sturdy. Any buyer would be getting a top-line driver. Wright is a smaller move. His 47% five-on-five share and 4 points in 16 games so far this season match a player who hasn't yet found his level. He joins a Nashville team that takes 46% of five-on-five expected goals but has been rescued by goaltending, 5.5 goals saved above expected. Wright arrives into a team that needs more shot quality, though he hasn't shown he can supply it yet.
